response.original_title: Infinity Train: Book Two - Cracked Reflection
response.overview: MT, a wanted reflection and a passenger named Jesse agree to help each other in exchange for companionship of Alan Dracula the shapeshifting deer. As MT, Jesse, and Alan Dracula travel together while on the run from two mirror police officers, they navigate their own personhood and learn they are not so different from each other.
response.tagline: A Whole New Adventure with a Familiar Face
